requirements.title: Fidäl, word and sentence tap-to-hear models
acceptance: Only exact approved target/variety/served hashes play.
Missing media offers a truthful supported activity; no Amharic fallback.

requirements.title: Normal, slow and repeat controls
acceptance: Normal/slow labels distinguish recorded slow speech from pitch-preserving speed changes.
Repeat is bounded and stoppable; retries do not become recall evidence.

requirements.title: Waveforms and reviewed segment timing
acceptance: Waveform has static/reduced-motion alternative and no pronunciation grade.
Only reviewed segment boundaries accompany sentence models.

requirements.title: Speaker, variety, rights and immutable recording/rendition data
acceptance: Private speaker evidence is not in public DTOs.
Every asset binds exact target, variety, rights and byte hashes.

requirements.title: Upload, technical validation and compression
acceptance: Decode bounded quarantined uploads without arbitrary network access.
Capture/encoder/hash/quality revisions are retained; technical QA is not native approval.

requirements.title: Independent native review and versioned publication
acceptance: Author cannot approve own material.
All core scopes plus two independent native audio decisions gate release.
Changed approval digests require re-review; recalls stop delivery.

requirements.title: CDN, licensed delivery and offline audio
acceptance: Only approved teaching media enters CDN.
Signed manifests and hashes verify dependencies; interrupted updates preserve active bundles.

requirements.title: Local recording, playback and self-comparison
acceptance: Microphone refusal and interruption have usable fallback.
No upload or correctness claim occurs from local self-reflection.

requirements.title: Consent-bound cloud processing and qualified human feedback
acceptance: Purpose/relationship/target eligibility checked before processing and result access.
Expiry, deletion and callback race tests prevent resurrecting recordings.

requirements.title: Correct, Close, Needs improvement and honest abstention
acceptance: Assessed labels require qualified human or validated-model rubric evidence.
Unsupported/silent/error conditions return not_assessed without a score.

requirements.title: Azure, Realtime, Whisper and hybrid evaluation
acceptance: Language support is checked for the exact feature.
No transcription-only pronunciation grade or unmeasured provider accuracy ranking.

requirements.title: Held-out quality, subgroup calibration and confidence
acceptance: Native reference agreement and held-out speaker/item splits exist.
False correction/acceptance confidence bounds and abstention meet adopted gates.

requirements.title: Skill-profile placement and heritage background
acceptance: Reading, listening, speaking and vocabulary remain separate.
Heritage is optional background, not an ordinal proficiency rank.
Missing skills/bank calibration return insufficient evidence.

requirements.title: Bayesian adaptive item selection and retest
acceptance: Pin calibrated bank, standard setting and posterior model.
Coverage/access/fatigue constrain selection; report 90% credible intervals.
Alternate-form retest does not reuse exposed items.

requirements.title: SM-2/FSRS/hybrid decision and service boundaries
acceptance: Keep current server SM-2 authority.
Use curriculum queue policy around a pinned model; avoid premature microservices.

requirements.title: Vocabulary, Fidäl, listening, pronunciation and patterns
acceptance: Evidence identifies target version, skill, task and assistance.
Recognition never fills speaking or transfer axes.

requirements.title: Retention, difficulty and forgetting-curve validity
acceptance: Eligible delayed independent denominator is explicit.
Predicted recall/difficulty/curves require calibrated models and uncertainty.

requirements.title: FSRS persistence, shadow replay and rollback
acceptance: Complete state/parameter/event provenance persisted.
No silent historical state rewrite or same-day interval inflation.

requirements.title: Daily, weekly, monthly calendars and practice time
acceptance: Optional nonpunitive adult calendars; no child streak pressure.
Adopted purpose/idle policy precedes study-time collection.

requirements.title: Heatmap, trajectory, skill tree and goals
acceptance: Heatmap intensity has a stated measure, not a mastery label.
Skill progression and goals use distinct independent/delayed evidence.

requirements.title: Words, fluency, listening, pronunciation and confidence
acceptance: Report scoped evidence, sample/date and missing assessments.
No universal fluency percentage or self-confidence-as-correctness.

requirements.title: Verified relationship dashboard and safety
acceptance: Show strengths, revisit needs, evidence and useful shared action.
Raw voice is not automatically shared with a dashboard role.

requirements.title: Purpose, COPPA/GDPR review and deletion
acceptance: Complete jurisdiction/legal-basis review before child cloud accounts.
Consent, rights and deletion are auditable; training/sharing are separate purposes.

requirements.title: Seven bounded communication contexts
acceptance: Family, airport, restaurant, shopping, taxi, healthcare and school each have reviewed objectives and prerequisites.
No invented Tigrinya branches ship.

requirements.title: Branching, feedback, reinforcement and rules/LLM/hybrid tradeoffs
acceptance: Reachability/termination/allowed-response tests validate deterministic graphs.
Later constrained language assistance cannot invent graded answers.

requirements.title: Lessons, stories, audio and incremental bundles
acceptance: Signed manifest, storage/cancel state, staged verified objects and atomic activation.
Release and entitlement leases fail safely without deleting learner work.

requirements.title: Sync, duplicates, two devices and clock conflicts
acceptance: Server grades idempotent typed events; client mastery is never authoritative.
Uncertain offline timing/performance remains provisional.

requirements.title: Revocation, logout and key lifecycle
acceptance: Disconnected takedown limits and lease policy are explicit.
Reconnection, expiry, device/account revocation and protected-cache purge are tested.

requirements.title: Contributor, Reviewer, Linguist, Moderator, Administrator
acceptance: Capabilities/qualifications and conflicts distinguish all roles.
Scope decisions, adjudication, attribution, payment and appeals have owners.

requirements.title: Culture integrated into teaching
acceptance: Traditions, music, food, holidays, proverbs, stories and history link to reviewed relevant language contexts.
Rights, age suitability, source perspective and regional variation are explicit.

requirements.title: Fidäl, left-to-right text and multimodal access
acceptance: Ethiopic rendering/input/NFC, wrapping and device fonts are checked.
Keyboard, screen reader, captions, motion and 44–48px controls have real validation before release.

requirements.title: Secure boundaries and child-safe operations
acceptance: Principal/relationship authorization, isolated uploads, managed identities and private storage.
No raw child speech/text/tokens in logs or unrelated project env use.

requirements.title: Outbox, retries, restore and service targets
acceptance: Idempotent jobs, bounded retries and billing reconciliation.
Restore/deletion drills establish any RPO/RTO/availability claim.

requirements.title: Costs, sustainable revenue and build versus buy
acceptance: Checked rates separate from unquoted allowances and excluded staffing/rights.
Native-first product stays viable when automated scoring is unsupported.

requirements.title: Roadmap, team, MVP/V2/V3 and risk ownership
acceptance: Phase exits require content/learning/privacy evidence, not generated screens.
Owner adoption, real staffing/identities/budgets and independent content review remain explicit gaps.

adoptionInputs.decision: Adopt proposed operational decisions without silently revising locked FINAL_V1.

adoptionInputs.owner: Qualified Tigrinya curriculum lead and native reviewers
adoptionInputs.decision: Select release objectives, varieties, transcripts, rights-cleared recordings, review roster and rubrics.
Choose launch jurisdictions, verified guardianship, legal bases, retention, processor agreements and child notices.
Supply actual Azure/Entra region, tenant, audience, origins, budgets, signing keys and restore/service targets.
Calibrate placement bank/cutpoints and separate speech evaluation benchmark before any automatic level/grade.
Adopt schema/API migrations, canonical signing protocol, actual handlers and release tests; document physical-device checks.
